frozen_candidate_root_contribution: hdy = to direct/set someone or something onto or toward a way leading to a destination. Form I (hadaY) transmits direction (show the route or grant arrival), Form VIII (ihtadaY) receives/enacts it (orient oneself, find the way), with the direction-content (hudaY), the director (haadin), the directed one (muhtadi), and the graded more-rightly-directed / more-guiding (ahdaY). The root is neutral as to whether the goal is good (it directs even to the path of Hell, 37:23) and as to whether the way is actually taken up (41:17, 76:3, 90:10). It does NOT itself supply salvific value, arrival/success, or a religion-only object-domain. A lexicalized concrete-object nominal sub-class (hady = animal driven to the sanctuary; hadiyya = gift sent to a recipient) sits off this nucleus and is not Quran-internally bridged to it by any live sense.

internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The core of hdy is directional: putting someone or something on a path toward a goal. Form I is the causative/transmitting side (a guide shows or brings someone onto a way), Form VIII is the resultative/middle side (a person finds or takes up the way, including literal navigation by the stars). Around the verbs cluster the direction itself (hudaY), the guide (haadin), the guided one (muhtadi), and a comparative (ahdaY). Crucially the word carries no built-in guarantee that the destination is good or that the person arrives: the same imperative leads people to the path of Hell (37:23), and God can show/direct Thamud who then choose blindness (41:17). Two frozen nouns from the same skeleton, hady (the sacrificial animal driven to the Kaaba) and hadiyya (a gift sent to someone), do not mean guidance at all and do not reduce to the directional nucleus on the text's own evidence.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: hdy does NOT entail: (1) a good/true destination - 37:23:4:2 directs to the path of the Hellfire, and disbelievers self-ascribe ahdaY (4:51, 43:24); (2) successful arrival or acceptance - Form I can merely present the way while the patient refuses (41:17:3:2, 76:3:2:1, 90:10 shows both roads); the Prophet can direct-toward (42:52:24:2) yet cannot effect a heart's guidance (28:56:3:1); (3) a religion-only domain - it covers stellar/road navigation (16:16:4:1, 6:97:6:2) and instinct/creation (20:50:9:1, 87:3:3:2); (4) give/transfer as a productive verbal sense - the gift/offering senses are nominal-only and never verbalized. The directional nucleus is always motion relative to a path (siraat/sabil/subul/najd), not free-floating illumination.
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: Two prongs. Against rightness-in-the-root: 37:23:4:2 faAhoduwhum ilaY SiraATi {lojaHiymi - the very imperative of hdy commands leading people TO THE PATH OF HELLFIRE; goodness is carried by the named goal, never by the root, so the nucleus is direction-neutral. Against whole-root unity: 27:35:4:2 mursilatun ilayhim bihadiy~apK (a pagan queen's diplomatic gift) and the cultic hady (2:196:16:2 HataY yabluga {lohadoyu maHil~ahu) are verb-less concrete-object nominals with no siraat/sabil, no wayfarer, no following, and never take the guidance verb; they share only a triliteral skeleton with 1:6 {hodinaA {lS~iraATa {lomusotaqiyma, so a single nucleus is NOT demonstrated to reach them.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: A single monosemous to-guide / guidance nucleus covering all 316. It is economical for ~90% of tokens but fails three internal tests: (a) direction-to-Hell (37:23) forces stripping right out of it, at which point it collapses into the weaker directional account; (b) the lexicalized hady/hadiyya are not guidance in any live sense and take no guidance verb; (c) it erases the deliberately exploited transmit-vs-receive (I vs VIII, e.g. 7:43:15 hadaY vs 7:43:19 nahotadiya; 17:97:2 yahdi vs 17:97:5 muhtadi) and show-vs-grant (42:52 vs 28:56) contrasts. The defender's fallback convey X toward a destination Y is rejected because it is non-distinctive (fits blgh/rsl/wjh/sbl equally, forbidden as a vague fits-everything abstraction) and undemonstrated for the object class (hadiyya is SENT/mursila, never led/driven).

internal_discovery.rationale: All three lenses independently converge: Class A (307 tokens: verb I, verb VIII, hudaY, haadin, ahdaY, muhtadi) forms one coherent derivational family around a directional nucleus, unified by minimal pairs proving I<->VIII are causative/resultative of one system (7:43, 17:97), sharpened by pervasive antonymy with D-l-l (16:93 yuDillu/yahdi; 2:16; 20:79; 93:7; 39:36), and anchored to path-imagery even in literal navigation (16:16, 6:97, 20:10). On Class A alone the account is broad, distinctive, and adversarially clean (37:23 hell, 41:17 refusal, 42:52 vs 28:56 turned into positive evidence), which would merit STRONG/REPRESENTATIVE. But the contract's grading rule caps this: a coherent, resistant, verb-less LEXICALIZED nominal sub-class (hady 7 + hadiyya 2 = 9) is bridgeable only by an inferential thing-directed-toward-a-destination/recipient abstraction that is non-distinctive and not Quran-internally demonstrated (the adversary shows the bridge fails precisely where it must hold: hadiyya is sent, never led; neither noun takes the guidance verb). A second, milder cap is the unresolved-but-refining show/grant polysemy inside Form I. Hence PREFERRED nucleus, but MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE, not STRONG/UNIVERSAL.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: haadin/haadi = the one who directs (a guide). Clusters in the D-l-l antithesis and in directing toward a SiraAT; frequently negated (there is no guide for whom God leaves astray).
clusters.classification_rationale: 10 active participles (pos N, surface haAd*/ha-di). Names the agent-role of the directional nucleus; the incapacity idiom 27:81/30:53 (you cannot guide the blind) reinforces the show-vs-grant boundary.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: ahdaY = comparative more rightly directed / more on the way (of persons) and more guiding (of a scripture, 28:49). Anchored to walking-a-path imagery (67:22).
clusters.classification_rationale: 7 elatives (pos N, surface >ahodaY`). The graded quality attaches to both a guided-person and a guiding-thing, staying within the directional nucleus; false self-ascription (4:51, 43:24) reinforces value-neutrality.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: muhtadi/muhtaduun = one in the directed (guided) state, participle of Form VIII; the self-orientation state, also used for FALSE self-attribution (7:30, 43:37).
clusters.classification_rationale: 21 form-VIII participles (pos N, verb_form VIII). Links Form-I agency to the resultant state (7:178:2 yahdi -> 7:178:5 muhtadi; 17:97 likewise), matching the middle-voice reception semantics.

clusters.candidate_semantic_interpretation: A frozen concrete-object sense: hady = the sacrificial animal(s) driven to the sanctuary; hadiyya = a gift sent to a recipient. NOT guidance in any live sense; connects to the directional nucleus only by an inferential thing-directed/sent-toward-a-destination-or-recipient abstraction that is non-distinctive and not Quran-internally demonstrated.
clusters.classification_rationale: 9 verb-less nominals (7 hady surface hadoY*; 2 hadiyya surface hadiy~*). No SiraAT/sabil, no wayfarer, no following, no destination-as-truth; never take the guidance verb; distributionally sealed off from Class A. hadiyya is SENT (mursila 27:35), never led/driven - the bridge fails where it must hold. Per contract this coherent resistant lexicalized sub-class caps the root at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
clusters.supporting_evidence_note: 2:196:16:2 HataY yabluga {lohadoyu maHil~ahu; 5:95:24:1 hadoyF baaliga {lokaEobapi; 48:25:8:3 wa{lohadoya maEokuwfFA an yabluga maHil~ahu; 5:2:12:2 and 5:97:10:3 al-hady listed as a bare sacred symbol with no directing verb; 27:35:4:2 mursilatun ilayhim bihadiy~apK; 27:36:15:2 bihadiy~atikum taforaHuwna.

reconciliation.rationale: The reaching-language is shared with blgh generally, not distinctive to hdy; hady is a verb-less concrete object never taking the guidance verb. The bridge is inferential/etymological, not a live synchronic identity.
hadiyya is mursila (sent), never led/driven; no path, wayfarer, or following. This is the adversary's strongest counterexample to whole-root unity and it stands.
Resolved as context-determined show-vs-grant polysemy of one form (indicate the route vs effect arrival), refining the nucleus rather than splitting it; kept inside the Form I cluster.

adversarial_verification.notes: The Class A directional nucleus survived the strongest attacks (37:23 direction-to-Hell, 41:17/76:3/90:10 no-uptake, 28:56 vs 42:52 show/grant), which turned into positive evidence, and the account is distinctive against D-l-l. But the lexicalized hady/hadiyya class resists bridging, so a full adversarial PASS with failing_occurrences=[] is not achievable; status is NOT_RUN (core holds, resistant sub-class recorded) rather than PASSED or FAILED.

Direction-neutral as to the goal's value and as to uptake.

independent_verification: Three independent lenses (A, B, adversary C) converged on the same nucleus, the same value-/uptake-neutral boundaries, and the same resistant lexicalized sub-class, with C pressing the hady/hadiyya seam hardest and still conceding Class A is clean.
candidate_root_contribution: hdy = to direct/set someone or something onto or toward a way leading to a destination. Form I (hadaY) transmits direction (show the route or grant arrival), Form VIII (ihtadaY) receives/enacts it (orient oneself, find the way), with the direction-content (hudaY), the director (haadin), the directed one (muhtadi), and the graded more-rightly-directed / more-guiding (ahdaY). The root is neutral as to whether the goal is good (it directs even to the path of Hell, 37:23) and as to whether the way is actually taken up (41:17, 76:3, 90:10). It does NOT itself supply salvific value, arrival/success, or a religion-only object-domain. A lexicalized concrete-object nominal sub-class (hady = animal driven to the sanctuary; hadiyya = gift sent to a recipient) sits off this nucleus and is not Quran-internally bridged to it by any live sense.

layer_attribution.derivation: Morphology partitions the family on a transmit/receive axis: Form I (hadaY, causative/transitive) vs Form VIII (ihtadaY, resultative/middle), with masdar hudaY (content), haadin (agent), muhtadi (state), ahdaY (grade) as derivational reflexes of the same nucleus; minimal pairs 7:43 and 17:97 fix the I<->VIII relation.
layer_attribution.lexical_class: hady (offering) and hadiyya (gift) are treated as a distinct LEXICALIZED concrete-object nominal class, verb-less and not governed by the guidance nucleus; this class is what caps the root at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE.
layer_attribution.contextual_relation: Value (good vs Hell), domain (religion vs stellar/road navigation vs instinct), and success (arrival vs refusal) are supplied by CONTEXT - the named destination, the agent, the object-class - not by the root. These contextual meanings are explicitly kept OUT of the root claim.
layer_attribution.reconciliation: Provisional bridges of the concrete nominals into the nucleus (via reaches-its-place / sent-toward) were raised and then rejected on verification as non-distinctive and undemonstrated; the show/grant Form I tension was reconciled as context-resolved polysemy and kept unified.
layer_attribution.unresolved_resistance: The hady/hadiyya lexicalized class remains unbridged (RESISTANT); whether one nucleus reaches it is left honestly open rather than forced. A milder, refining (not resisting) residue is the context-dependence of show vs grant within Form I.

hard_case_representation.rationale: The hady/hadiyya lexicalized concrete-object nominals (9 tokens) genuinely persist as resistant into the final judgment: no Quran-internal bridge to the guidance nucleus survives verification (the gift is sent not led; neither noun takes the guidance verb; no shared path-imagery). They are recorded as RESISTANT_SEAM hard cases and as counterevidence, and they are the reason the root is capped at MODERATE/REPRESENTATIVE rather than STRONG/UNIVERSAL. 37:23 is included as an ADVERSARIAL_BOUNDARY that confirms rather than resists the value-neutral nucleus.

rejection_condition.challenging_finding: A Quranic occurrence in which the Form I or Form VIII verb of hdy productively means drive an animal (as offering) or give/send a present, OR a hady/hadiyya token that carries live directional/path semantics (SiraAT/sabil, a wayfarer, following) - either would show the concrete-object class is genuinely bridged and the derivational-family scope understated; conversely, a verb of hdy that entails a GUARANTEED good destination or GUARANTEED arrival would overturn the value-neutral, uptake-neutral nucleus.
rejection_condition.search_location: Verb clusters (144 Form I + 40 Form VIII) checked for any drive/give reflex; the 9 hady/hadiyya nominals checked for path-imagery or a guidance verb; and the ~20x laa yahdi al-qawma al-... set plus 37:23 plus 41:17/76:3/90:10 checked for entailed goodness/arrival.
rejection_condition.verification_method: Enumerate every verbal token's object and complement (ilaY/li-/accusative) and confirm it is a way/destination, not a slaughter-animal or present; enumerate the 9 nominals and confirm absence of a directing verb and of path-participants; confirm at least one token each of direction-to-evil (37:23) and directed-but-refused (41:17) exists.
rejection_condition.confounder_control: Reject etymological/diachronic bridges and mere compatibility (absence of resistance is not proof); a bridging abstraction must be distinctive to hdy (not equally satisfied by blgh/rsl/wjh/sbl) and positively exhibited in the text, not merely inferable.
rejection_condition.failure_consequence: If the concrete class is shown genuinely bridged, upgrade toward STRONG and possibly UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION; if a verb is found entailing guaranteed good arrival, narrow the nucleus and split show/grant into distinct lexemes, weakening the single-nucleus claim.

reopen_conditions: If a Quran-internal reading is found where the hady (offering) or hadiyya (gift) nominal exhibits live directional/path semantics or is governed by a Form I/VIII guidance verb, re-test whether the concrete-object class bridges into the nucleus and reconsider upgrading scope to UNIVERSAL/ROOT_GENERALIZATION.

If the show-vs-grant tension in Form I (42:52 tahdi ilaY vs 28:56 laa tahdi man ahbabta) is shown to track a fixed morphological or syntactic conditioning rather than context, reopen to split Form I into two lexemes and re-grade.
If a verb of hdy is found entailing a guaranteed good destination or guaranteed arrival (contra 37:23 and 41:17), reopen the value-neutral / uptake-neutral boundary.

falsification_evidence.status_rationale: The Class A directional nucleus survived the strongest attacks (37:23 direction-to-Hell, 41:17/76:3/90:10 no-uptake, 28:56 vs 42:52 show/grant), which turned into positive evidence, and the account is distinctive against D-l-l. But the lexicalized hady/hadiyya class resists bridging, so a full adversarial PASS with failing_occurrences=[] is not achievable; status is NOT_RUN (core holds, resistant sub-class recorded) rather than PASSED or FAILED.
